tokyo-miura-peninsula-coastal-loop.title: Tokyo · Miura Peninsula Coastal Morning
tokyo-miura-peninsula-coastal-loop.slogan: A 151 km loop out of Tokyo bay exit
tokyo-miura-peninsula-coastal-loop.story: Sea air, compact bends and an easy coastal reset south of the city. A 151 km loop that starts and ends near Tokyo, about 3 h 23 of riding. It goes by way of Yokohama, Kamakura, Hayama coastal road and Jogashima water stop.

scenicChapters.title: Hayama coastal road → Jogashima water stop
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 20 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

tokyo-miura-peninsula-coastal-loop.storyWas: Sea air, compact bends and an easy coastal reset south of the city.

sections.advice: Enumclaw → Mount Rainier Sunrise junction is 52 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Mount Rainier Sunrise junction → Chinook Pass climbs about 1656 m in 13 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Chinook Pass → Naches drops about 1656 m over 80 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Chinook Pass Scenic Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1656 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Chinook Pass → Naches
scenicChapters.narrative: 144 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

chinook-pass-scenic-byway.story: From Enumclaw it runs 261 km to Tieton; allow about 3 h 31 of riding. The stops in between: Mount Rainier Sunrise junction and Chinook Pass. The highest point is about 1,650 m. Chinook Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
